stem: Ben wants to add a closing sentence to reinforce the controlling idea of his paper. Which of the following ideas could best follow sentence 25 and help accomplish this goal?

options.label: A
options.text: You just have to be willing to pay it forward.

options.label: B
options.text: You don’t have to start the fire; you just have to be a spark.

options.label: C
options.text: It doesn’t take money to be a highly effective person.

options.label: D
options.text: Hard work always pays off in the end.
